new_api_calls: bounded single attempt per RGB scene
benchmark_type: new articulated tasks with sensor-grounded typed line/hinge models and cuRobo multi-IK
unknown_space_policy: only measured occupied surfaces checked; unseen geometry is not certified
drawer_travel_policy: 15 cm observed travel with up to 16 cm hand command; fixed margin for observed/controller error
placement_orientation_policy: soft preference; terminal object support-point target
sensor_capture_policy: fresh direct render after current-state kinematic refresh; same state for RGB-D, calibration and robot prior
finger_clearance_policy: unrelated surfaces must not penetrate; arm/palm retain 1 mm margin; selected task contacts explicitly permitted
collision_clearance_policy: block penetration for fingers and observed payload; log positive gaps under 1 mm; arm/palm retain 1 mm clearance
source_scene_update: current connected measured source component within fixed tracked-body bounds; stationary world support plane
source_support_separation: RGB selected source 1st/99th bounds plus observed table upper band; table stays stationary
selected_destination_pickup_contact: allowed while payload remains within 2.5 cm horizontal/height of initial pickup; expires after separation
ik_postvalidation: VAMP self collision plus v11 full robot observed surfaces and explicit contacts
approach_endpoint_policy: backward Cartesian continuation anchored to the exact admitted grasp joint posture
continuation_ik_policy: closest robot-valid posture within hard joint reserve
grounding_policy: two RGB camera views, DINO proposals, predicted masks and bounded typed choices
mechanism_policy: measured panel normal for prismatic; RGB hinge edge or control-face normal for revolute; rigid contact orientation coupled to motion
physical_goal_success: native LIBERO predicate only; all planned episodes count
task_template_priors: upright panel geometry; fixed travel/angle choices; no simulator hinge/slide values
pilot_protocol: five new tasks, one official state each, strict admission and paired physics diagnostic
admission_horizon_policy: 3 cm or 0.2 rad; replan from measured RGB-D feedback
grasp_search_order: one IK rank across all eligible grasp poses before additional redundancy ranks
